children: Ratos agreed to divest its entire Kvd Group holding to Remman Mobility Group AB. The deal has SEK 715M enterprise value and approximately SEK 630M equity value; closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to customary regulatory approvals.

Equity value approximately SEK 630M

Enterprise value SEK 715M
Sets the stated transaction valuation, but does not alone establish the proceeds attributable to Ratos.
Estimated cash flow effect approximately SEK 700M
Would provide cash on closing; the estimate is subject to final amounts being determined after closing.
Estimated capital loss approximately SEK 180M
Signals a reported loss on the disposal; the majority is stated to have no cash flow impact.
Kvd Group to be discontinued from Q4 2026
Changes Ratos’ reported continuing operations before expected completion of the transaction.
Closing expected in Q1 2027, subject to approvals
